description: Returns the headers and bodies of one captured request, to inspect a candidate that `find_requests_containing` ranked. Each body is cut to 20000 characters by default; a cut body comes with `requestBodyTruncation` or `responseBodyTruncation` (total size and `nextOffset`). Page with `offset`, or pass `maxChars` or `full`. Unlike the other tools, headers are raw: cookie and authorization values are visible. Read them for diagnosis; do not repeat them to the developer or write them to a file.

full.description: Return the whole text, ignoring `maxChars`. It can be megabytes, so prefer paging with `offset`.

offset.description: Character offset to start from, such as a previous `nextOffset`. Default 0.

name: get_request
